submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Carefully repaint Image 1 into one opaque native 1254x1254 game-map detail square at exactly the same framing, camera, scale and coordinates. This target contains ONLY empty ivory stone paving, a broad curved ivory stone border running vertically left of center, and soft tree shadows entering from the far right. No visible objects. Retain every shown paving joint route and endpoint, the widths and curves of the stone border and the positions of the soft shadows. The leftmost 230 pixels are true already-generated neighbor pixels: preserve them exactly and smoothly continue their fine stone seams, colors and shading into the remaining image. The pasted guide strip boundary must not become a straight vertical edge or line. Reconstruct the soft interior as clean precise hand-painted stone faces, fine rounded bevels and crisp shallow joints without increasing the mapped scale or inventing structure. Do not move, enlarge, recrop, rotate, replace or add anything. NO visible foliage, planter, railings, lanterns, flowers, medallions, symbols, buildings, people, extra objects, text, UI, border or watermark. Image 2 is ONLY the user-approved primary style reference for bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painting and warm restrained material shading; copy none of its objects or decoration. Keep quiet ivory pavement, soft daylight and clear contours; no gritty cracks, noise, excessive marbling, plastic shine, blur or sharpening halos. Return only the same full-bleed paving detail square, highest available fidelity.
